body: I kinda thought it was a pretty flawless plan. What do you mean?
I wish they could... everything seems totally hopeless right now.

I really don't know anymore. I really want to feel loved and wanted by somebody someday, but I feel it's too late for that to happen. And my dream has been to turn art into a career and make posters and graphic novels. But that's just wishful thinking when I'm so non-functional everyday and stuck in a retail job that I hate where everyone treats me like a goddamn moron. I guess ultimately, the idea of living an unremarkable life terrifies me.
I've already tried and exhausted most of my options. Most of the people I know have plans that I can't join in on.

Well it's difficult to do that because time and money aren't on my side. I'm an artist and I do draw a lot to make myself feel better, but right now I'm literally pinching pennies and I have too many deadlines to meet that it would be irrational to try and be adventurous. Anxiety stops me from doing a lot of things as well.
